test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Their vision was very clear: if Indians were to play a meaningful role in the community of nations, they must be second to none in the __application__ of advanced technologies to their real-life problems.
solution:
The correct answer is-** "implementation".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"implementation"** is the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
 
• **Implementation: **The carrying out or application of a plan
 
 
• **Example: **The new education policy will be be implemented in schools from the next month.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 2)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options as well.

 
• **Mistreatment: **To treat badly

 
 
• **Example:** The **mistreatment** of his wife led her mental sickness.
 
 
 
• **Corruption: **dishonesty
 
 
• **Example:** The** corruption** in political parties have made the nation poor.
 
 
 
• **Misuse: **incorrect, improper, or careless use
 
 
• **Example: **The kids have started **misusing** the smartphones.
